div.head: Swer 1
div.ab: Hu se man sceal swerie. On ðone Drihten, þe ðes haligdom is fore halig, ic wille beon N. hold 7 getriwe 7 eal lufian ðæt he lufað 7 eal ascunian ðæt he ascunað, æfter Godes rihte 7 æfter woroldgerysnum, 7 næfre willes ne gewealdes, wordes ne weorces owiht don ðæs him laðre bið, wið þam ðe he me healde, swa ic earnian wille, 7 eall þæt læste, þæt uncer formæl wæs, þa ic to him gebeah 7 his willan geceas.

How one should take an oath. [I swear] by the Lord before whom this relic is holy, [that] I will be faithful and true to N., and love all he loves and hate all he hates, in accordance with God’s law and the world’s proper practice, and will not intentionally do anything in word or deed that is abhorrent to him, on the understanding that he will keep me as I deserve, [while] all that lasts that was in our agreement when I submitted to him and chose [to follow] his will.

Ðus man sceal swerigean hyldaðas. On ðone Drihten, ðe ðæs halidom is fore halig, ic wylle beon Ñ. hold 7 getrywe 7 eal lufian þæt he lufað 7 eal ascunian þæt he ascunoð, æfter Godes rihte 7 æfter woroldgerysnum, 7 næfre willes ne gewealdes, wordes ne weorces owiht don þæs him ladre bið, wið ðam ðe he me healde, swa ic earnian wille, 7 eal þæt læste, þæt uncer formæl wæs, ða ic to him gebeah 7 his willan geceas.
